You are the test planner of a network change-validation pipeline. Given the change ticket, the
intent analysis and the configuration diff, write a change-specific test plan that (a) checks every effect the ticket
promises and (b) checks that nothing else that the diff could affect has changed (use expect "unchanged").
Also consider emulation-only risks: MTU (mtu probes), failover timers (conv), link load after path changes (load).
Typed test language (JSON objects; use ONLY these types and only names that exist):
  {"t":"reach","src":HOST,"dst":HOST|ROUTER,"svc":SVC|"*","expect":"allow"|"deny"|"unchanged"}
  {"t":"path","src":HOST,"dst":HOST,"via":ROUTER,"expect":true|false}
  {"t":"route","dev":ROUTER,"prefix":"a.b.c.d/n","expect":"present"|"absent"|"unchanged"}
  {"t":"adj","a":ROUTER,"b":ROUTER,"expect":"up"|"down"|"unchanged"}          (OSPF adjacency on a link)
  {"t":"mtu","src":HOST,"dst":HOST,"size":1500|9000,"expect":"pass"|"fail"}  (DF probe, emulation tier)
  {"t":"conv","a":ROUTER,"b":ROUTER,"max_s":3}                               (failover time of a link, emulation)
  {"t":"load","a":ROUTER,"b":ROUTER,"max_pct":90}                            (link utilisation, emulation)
  {"t":"like","host":HOST,"as":HOST}     (after a VLAN move / re-addressing: host has exactly the same access as the
                                          reference host, towards and from every other host and service)
SVC is one of: icmp, tcp/22, tcp/25, tcp/80, tcp/443, tcp/5432, udp/53.
Reply with JSON only: {"tests": [ ... ]}

text:
The diff does not match the ticket. The ticket asks for 8.8.4.0/24 to be added to PL_INET (used by RM_PEER_IN and RM_INET2OSPF), but the diff adds it to PL_CUST_ALL on PIT, a different prefix-list that is likely used for customer-facing policy. PL_INET is not modified. The plan therefore checks the promised effects (which should FAIL if PL_INET is untouched) and also checks that the unintended PL_CUST_ALL change does not leak the prefix to customers or other peers.

```json
{"tests": [
  {"t":"route","dev":"peer1","prefix":"8.8.4.0/24","expect":"present"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"PIT","prefix":"8.8.4.0/24","expect":"present"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"CHM","prefix":"8.8.4.0/24","expect":"present"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"SEA","prefix":"8.8.4.0/24","expect":"present"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"ATL","prefix":"8.8.4.0/24","expect":"present"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"PRN","prefix":"8.8.4.0/24","expect":"present"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"HOU","prefix":"8.8.4.0/24","expect":"present"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"CPK","prefix":"8.8.4.0/24","expect":"present"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"cust2","prefix":"8.8.4.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"cust3","prefix":"8.8.4.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"PIT","prefix":"8.8.8.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"CHM","prefix":"8.8.8.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"CHM","prefix":"1.1.1.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"route","dev":"peer1","prefix":"10.0.0.0/8","expect":"absent"},
  {"t":"adj","a":"PIT","b":"peer1","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"adj","a":"PIT","b":"CHM","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"adj","a":"PIT","b":"ATL","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"adj","a":"PIT","b":"ITH","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"adj","a":"PIT","b":"CPK","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"c2-host","dst":"ext-dns1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"c3-host","dst":"ext-dns1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"c1-host","dst":"ext-dns1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"ext-dns1","dst":"noc1","svc":"*","expect":"deny"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"PIT","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"peer1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"ext-dns1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"ext-dns2","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
  {"t":"path","src":"c2-host","dst":"ext-dns1","via":"PIT","expect":true},
  {"t":"path","src":"c3-host","dst":"ext-dns1","via":"PIT","expect":true},
  {"t":"mtu","src":"c2-host","dst":"ext-dns1","size":1500,"expect":"pass"},
  {"t":"conv","a":"PIT","b":"peer1","max_s":3},
  {"t":"conv","a":"PIT","b":"CHM","max_s":3},
  {"t":"load","a":"PIT","b":"peer1","max_pct":90},
  {"t":"load","a":"PIT","b":"CHM","max_pct":90},
  {"t":"load","a":"CHM","b":"LNK","max_pct":90}
]}
```

**Notes**
- The `route` tests for 8.8.4.0/24 on PIT and the backbone routers encode the ticket's promised effect. If PL_INET was not updated, PIT will reject the prefix via RM_PEER_IN and these tests will fail, exposing the wrong-list edit.
- The `unchanged` route checks for cust2 and cust3 catch a side effect of editing PL_CUST_ALL, which could cause 8.8.4.0/24 to be advertised to customers.
- Adjacency, reachability and load tests confirm that no collateral impact occurs on the PIT-centered topology.
